cover.coreProposition: Forked-agent contexts need two separate control planes: typed lineage must preserve whether instructions are inherited, replaced or child-local across derivation, while independent authority records must identify the principal, policy source and scope that permit those instructions.
cover.visualMetaphor: A single archival thread forks into a child ribbon carrying a clear origin seal beside a separate authorization key
cover.semanticObject: One forked ribbon with a provenance seal and a distinct key-shaped object
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a sweeping parent-to-child curve, restrained violet and gold palette, two clearly separate semantic objects and deep negative space
